summary.result: The research seeks to demonstrate that the CTCN TA provides the means and opportunities to build a solid CDM project based on a number of merits.
summary.background: In this study, researchers attempt to preemptively propose a strategy for how to approach this transition by linking the Technology Mechanism and CDM, based on empirical analysis of the CTCN TA‐CDM project to deploy desalination technology in a coastal area of Bangladesh.
summary.method: The Bangladesh case is the first case to link the CTCN TA to a CDM project showing the synergetic effects of the linkage model of CTCN TA‐CDM.
